entry.title: Covenants.diy: a node editor for covenant scripts
entry.summary:
The latest advancements in programming opcodes provide a flexible framework for developers, allowing them to enable various combinations of opcodes as per their project requirements. The currently implemented opcodes include `OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY`, `OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK`, `OP_CAT`, `ANYPREVOUT`, `OP_TEMPLATEHASH`, `OP_INTERNALKEY`, `OP_PAIRCOMMIT`, and `OP_TXHASH`. These tools are integral for developers looking to innovate or enhance security protocols within their applications.
Further developments are underway with the addition of `OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY` and `OP_VAULT`. These enhancements aim to broaden the utility and security features available, facilitating more robust covenant protocol constructions. This ongoing development is designed to support the sharing and research of new covenant protocols, making these innovations more accessible and easier to implement within the community.
